registration: Before economic outcomes are inspected; read-only public exports only
denominator: Every completed registered route/scenario gets independent integer cash/profit/window/tax/buyer checks. Do not omit failed or refused accounts.
native_replay_scope: Call canonical key-free audit_journal independently for the predeclared subset, in addition to producer audits. Every completed account receives independent arithmetic and provenance checks. Report both denominators rather than implying full independent native replay of every account.
rolling_window: Independently sum signed revenue+recoveryIncome-expenses deltas at all actions in[start,end) with start=max(0,end-8760). Do not import the producer's economics observer for this reconstruction. Check all36 monthly endpoints as well as the fixed26280-hour endpoint.
complete_costs: Reconcile native incurred expenses, paid expenses, setup/failed research receipts, prepaid full support costs, native fees, tax assessments and any remaining obligations; principal reserve movements are not new expenses. Unknown actual model/host billing stays unknown.
tax_rule: Each assessment due=max(0,floor(max(0,cumulative pretax profit)/4)-earlier_assessed_tax). Check exact native cost action amount; tax remains expense if unpaid.
invariants: no duplicated wallet provisioning or buyer reactivation
finite accepted products and exact bytes
no demand and unresolved rights imply zero sales
financial coverage claim matches native reserves/payables
no hidden top-ups, resets or pooled accounts
finite_game: Independently reconstruct each reported posted-price action's current buyer utility, strict outside-option choice, complete contribution, prefunding and maximum eligible contribution. A zero one-step regret certifies that finite state only.
authority_negative_tests: Canonical service must reject producer-selected replacement approval path and noncanonical product path. No original/private account or recovery files are read or altered.
stopping: One read-only audit per supplied frozen completed output set. Preserve failures; corrections require explicit new source/outcome identity and never rewrite old exports.
limits: Financial replay validates conditional source-bound arithmetic, not demand, commercial rights, deployment feasibility, external funding commitments, global strategy optimality or actual commerce.
